error.message: Column SCDS11: a second liquid would form on stages 1, 2 (stage 1 at 342.8 K: its liquid Ethanol 0.04786, Water 0.3092, Ethyl acetate 0.6429 splits off a liquid Ethanol 0.01177, Water 0.9788, Ethyl acetate 0.009475). With phases "VL" the column holds one liquid on each stage, so it does not return this answer. Turn on "look for two liquids on the stages" (phases "VLL", activity models only), or change the feed or the specifications, or separate the liquids first (a decanter: the flash drum).
